When I saw that ole ship that was sailing[/tab]
[tab]            [ch]G[/ch]           [ch]D[/ch]      [ch]G[/ch]

[tab][ch]G[/ch]            [ch]D[/ch]        [ch]C[/ch]

[tab]        [ch]G[/ch]          [ch]D[/ch]        [ch]G[/ch]
